links.comparator_used: Pre-intervention period without email notification of model output (before/after comparison)
links.outcome: Documented ACP conversations (increased) and end-of-life care outcomes (unchanged)
links.effect: ACP documented in 2.3% preintervention vs 80.5% postintervention (P<0.001); no differences in LOS, hospice referral, code status change, ICU admissions or LOS, 30-day readmissions, 30-day ED visits, or inpatient and 30-day deaths
links.tradeoff: No improvement in EOL care outcomes; small non-randomized before/after cohorts
links.quote: ACP conversations were documented for 2.3% of hospitalizations preintervention vs. 80.5% postintervention (P<0.001), and if the attending physician notified was a palliative care specialist (4.1% vs. 84.6%) or oncologist (0% vs. 76.3%) (P<0.001).

links.comparator_used: Pre-intervention usual care without model-based identification of high-mortality-risk patients
links.outcome: Documented ACP conversations for patients flagged high-risk (increased) and end-of-life care outcomes (unchanged)
links.effect: ACP documented in 2.3% preintervention vs 80.5% postintervention (P<0.001); no differences in LOS, hospice referral, code status change, ICU use, readmissions, ED visits, or deaths
links.tradeoff: No impact on EOL care outcomes; single-site, small cohorts, before/after design
links.quote: ACP conversations were documented for 2.3% of hospitalizations preintervention vs. 80.5% postintervention (P<0.001), and if the attending physician notified was a palliative care specialist (4.1% vs. 84.6%) or oncologist (0% vs. 76.3%) (P<0.001).

design_hint: Clinician email notification of high-risk predictions to prompt advance care planning
